description: This file contains the definition of the Store class in the OpenCart system. The class extends the base Controller and provides functionality to display store information and manage store sessions in OpenCart.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Controller class for the store module, responsible for managing store display and session handling.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that gathers store information and renders the store module view, or returns an empty string if the store module is disabled.
